BEFORE THE STATE OFFICE OF ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS

SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-26-16349
PUC DOCKET NO. 59475

Application of Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC

and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation for
Amendment of Certificates of Convenience and Necessity
for the Bell County East to Big Hill 765-kV

Transmission Line Project

INTERVENOR [YOUR FULL NAME]'S RESPONSE TO APPLICANTS’

OBJECTION AND MOTION TO RETAIN INTERVENOR STATUS

l. INTRODUCTION

Intervenor Cathy Anderson respectfully submits this Response to the Applicants’
objection and to any Motion to Dismiss or list filed by Oncor Electric Delivery Company
LLC ("Oncor") and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation ("LCRA TSC")
(collectively, "Applicants") purporting to identify [YOUR FULL NAME] as an intervenor
who did not timely file a Statement of Position or direct testimony in the above-
referenced docket.

This Response demonstrates that: (1) Cathy Anderson timely filed a Statement of
Position in compliance with SOAH Order No. 6 and P.U.C. Proc. R. 22.124: (2) the filing
Satisfies all applicable requirements for a Statement of Position; and (3) dismissal of this
Intervenor would be unjust, contrary to the public interest, and inconsistent with the
PUCT's stated policy of encouraging participation by directly affected landowners.
intervenor respectfully requests that the Administrative Law Judges ("ALJs") deny any
motion to dismiss, confirm Intervenor's status as a party, and allow Intervenor to
participate fully in the Hearing on the Merits scheduled for June 8—12, 2026.

ll. BACKGROUND AND PROCEDURAL HISTORY

Cathy Anderson is a directly affected landowner whose family property is located within
Route U5, Parcels 4768 and 4769, in San Saba County, Texas. The property has been
in continuous family ownership and operation for over 75 years. Intervenor timely filed a
Request to Intervene, which was accepted. Intervenor is appearing pro se in this
proceeding.

SOAH Order No. 6, issued April 20, 2026, established May 13, 2026, as the deadline for
intervenors to file written direct testimony or a Statement of Position. Intervenor Cathy
Anderson; Rock Lick Branch, LP; McGregor filed a Statement of Position on or before
May 13, 2026, via the PUCT Interchange, designated as INTERCHANGE ITEM
NUMBER 3727. The filing was titled "Intervenor's Statement of Position and Direct
Testimony of Cathy Anderson POA for Forrest McGregor and Sylvia McGregor and
Rock Lick Branch, LP and was filed under PUC Docket No. 59475.

Despite this timely filing, Applicants have objected on the grounds that Intervenor did
not file a Statement of Position or direct testimony. This objection is incorrect and should
be denied.

lil. ARGUMENT


 A. Intervenor Timely Filed a Statement of Position That Satisfies Applicable
Requirements.

SOAH Order No. 6 and P.U.C. Proc. R. 22.124 require intervenors to file “either written
direct testimony or a statement of position" by the prescribed deadline. Intervenor
satisfied this requirement by timely filing a Statement of Position on or before May 13,
2026.

A Statement of Position is not required to be sworn testimony, is not required to meet
the evidentiary standards of Texas Rules of Evidence 602, 701, or 702, and is not
subject to cross-examination. As the ALJs have noted in prior PUCT CCN proceedings,
a "statement of position clarifies a party's position" and serves the distinct function of
preserving intervenor status and placing the party's concerns before the tribunal.
Intervenor's filing accomplishes exactly that.

Intervenor's Statement of Position set forth in detail:

(1) Intervenor's identity and property interest (Route U5, Parcels 4768 and 4769);

(2) Intervenor's opposition to Route U5 and the relief requested;

(3) The economic harm to Intervenor's parents, whose sole retirement income derives
from grazing and hunting leases on the affected property;

(4) Significant natural and ecological resources located within the proposed route
corridor, including 200-year-old oak trees, a natural spring, limestone bluffs, creek
crossings, and state-certified Managed Lands Deer (MLD) Program habitat documented
by a Texas Parks and Wildlife Department State Biologist report; and

(5) The applicable PUCT statutory routing criteria under which Route U5 should be
rejected or modified.

This filing plainly constitutes a Statement of Position under any reasonable reading of
SOAH Order No. 6 and the applicable procedural rules. Applicants’ objection to the
contrary is without merit.

B. If the ALJ Determines That Intervenor's Filing Requires Supplementation,
Intervenor Requests Leave to Cure.

In the alternative, if the ALJs find any technical deficiency in Intervenor's filing,
intervenor respectfully requests leave to supplement or re-file the Statement of Position
to cure any such deficiency. Good cause exists for such leave:

(1) Intervenor is a pro se landowner who has no legal training and no ability to retain
counsel. Directly affected landowners proceeding without attorneys are entitled to
reasonable accommodation in procedural matters, consistent with the PUCT's stated
policy of encouraging landowner participation.

(2) Intervenor filed in good faith and on time. Any deficiency is technical, not
substantive. The Statement of Position was filed by the May 13, 2026 deadline and
placed Applicants and the ALJs on clear notice of Intervenor's position and the issues in
dispute.

(3) No prejudice to Applicants. Allowing Intervenor to cure any technical deficiency
would impose no prejudice or additional burden on Applicants. A Statement of Position
is not admissible as evidence and does not expand the scope of the proceeding; it
merely preserves Intervenor's right to participate.

(4) The public interest favors participation. The PUCT has repeatedly recognized
that "[a]s a landowner, you have detailed knowledge of the impacted area that might not


 be reflected in the application.” Dismissing a directly affected landowner whose property
has been in continuous family use for over 75 years — on a technical procedural ground
— would deprive the ALJs and the Commission of material evidence regarding
significant natural, ecological, and economic resources in the proposed route corridor.

C. Dismissal of This Intervenor Would Be Contrary to Law and the Public Interest.
Prior PUCT CCN proceedings have recognized that pro se landowners who file
Statements of Position in good faith and on time should not be dismissed on hyper-
technical grounds. See, e.g., Docket No. 54936 (ALJ granted motion to allow late-filed
statements of position filed two days late, finding good cause and no prejudice to other
parties).

Here, Intervenor's filing was timely. Route U5, Parcels 4768 and 4769, directly traverses
Intervenor's family ranch, which contains irreplaceable natural resources — including
200-year-old oak trees, a natural spring, limestone bluffs, and creek crossings — as
well as state-certified deer management habitat and the sole source of retirement
income for elderly parents. These are precisely the kinds of community values, historical
and aesthetic values, and environmental integrity concerns that the PUCT is mandated
by statute to weigh in routing decisions. The Commission cannot make a well-informed
decision without this Intervenor's evidence.

IV. RELIEF REQUESTED

For the foregoing reasons, Intervenor Cathy Anderson respectfully requests that the
ALJs:

1. DENY any motion by Applicants to dismiss Intervenor from this proceeding,

2. CONFIRM that Intervenor's Statement of Position filed on or before May 13, 2026,
satisfies the requirements of SOAH Order No. 6 and P.U.C. Proc. R. 22.124;

3. In the alternative, GRANT Intervenor leave to supplement or re-file the Statement of
Position within such time as the ALJUs deem appropriate to cure any technical deficiency;

4. RETAIN Intervenor on the service list as a party to this proceeding; and
5. ALLOW Intervenor to participate fully in the Hearing on the Merits scheduled for June

8-12, 2026, including by appearing and presenting the State Biologist's MLD report and
other evidence regarding Route U5, Parcels 4768 and 4769.

V. ATTESTATION
|, Cathy Anderson, declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct
to the best of my knowledge and belief, and that the Statement of Position referenced

herein was timely filed in PUC Docket No. 59475 via the PUCT Interchange on or
before May 13, 2026.

Respectfully submitted,

ALhatr.

Cathy Anderggn
Pro Se Intervenor
5013 92nd St.
Lubbock, TX 79424


 806-787-8740
cathy@e3professionaltrainers.com

Date ju 2 1 2006

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE

| hereby certify that on the date shown above, a true and correct copy of the foregoing
Response was served upon all parties of record in PUC Docket No. 59475 via the
PUCT Interchange electronic filing system and/or by email or mail to all parties on the
service list in accordance with the procedural rules of this proceeding.

Cathy Renee Anderson, POA for Sylvia McGregor

(Forrest McGregor is recently deceased on May 20, 2026, since my previous filing of
Statement of Position)
